patterns_discovered.description: Breaking down a large monolithic views.py file into domain-specific modules
Using Python package structure (views_new/) instead of single module for better code organization and maintainability
Creating comprehensive docstrings in __init__.py before implementation to establish intent and module contracts

gotchas_discovered.description: Using 'views_new' directory name suggests parallel implementation strategy alongside existing 'views.py', requiring careful import management during transition
Five separate view modules will need coordinated refactoring to ensure all views from original monolithic file are properly distributed

approach_outcome.implementation_strategy: Created package structure with descriptive documentation outlining planned module organization for purchasing app views

recommendations.recommendation: Implement individual view modules in planned order, starting with dashboard.py to establish patterns for remaining modules
Define __all__ export list in __init__.py once modules are created to control public API of views package
Plan gradual migration from views.py to views_new/ with compatibility layer or parallel imports during transition period
Establish test structure mirroring new module organization to support incremental testing during refactoring
